# RIINA™

> Rigorous Immutable Invariant, No Assumptions

RIINA is a formally verified programming language with Bahasa Melayu (Malaysian) keywords.
Security properties are mathematically proven at compile time.

- File extension: `.rii`
- Version: 0.3.0
- Keywords: Bahasa Melayu (Malaysian) + English dual syntax
- Repository: https://github.com/ib823/riina
- License: Proprietary

## Verified State (2026-03-19, command-derived)

- Coq: 11,905 Qed (active build, 0 Admitted, 0 Axioms), 301 .v files
- Lean 4: 12,096 theorems (317 files, 0 sorry), claim: mechanized
- Isabelle: 12,287 lemmas (354 files, 0 sorry), claim: mechanized
- TLA+: 11,839 theorems (309 files), claim: mechanized
- SMT/Z3: 11,962 assertions (309 files), claim: mechanized
- F*: 22 lemmas (307 files), claim: compiled
- Alloy: 11,240 assertions (299 files), claim: compiled
- Verus: 6,008 proof fns (316 files), claim: generated
- Kani: 5,277 harnesses (300 files), claim: generated
- TV: 16,917 validations (308 files), claim: generated
- Total: 71,351 proof artifacts across 10 provers
- Rust: 2,294 tests, 16 crates, 0 external dependencies
- Examples: 143 .rii files

## Session Protocol

All LLM CLIs MUST follow RIINA_MASTER_PLAN.md Part 8 (8 mandatory steps):
ORIENT → ASSESS → DECIDE → VERIFY BEFORE → EXECUTE → VERIFY AFTER → UPDATE → HANDOFF

All work on `main` branch only. Never commit to `public` or `gh-pages`.
Commit-Push-Deploy: stage specific files → commit [TRACK_X] TYPE: → push (never --no-verify) → sync-public.sh → sync-metrics.sh → deploy-website.sh

## Quick Syntax Reference

```riina
// Functions with effect declarations
fungsi tambah(x: Nombor, y: Nombor) -> Nombor kesan Bersih {
    pulang x + y;
}

// Actors (JALINAN Phase 6)
pelakon Pembilang {
    keadaan: Nombor
    kendalikan Tambah(n) {
        n + 1
    }
}

biar k = lahir Pembilang(0);
hantar(k, 5);
terima(k)

// Choreography (multiparty session types)
koreografi Pembelian {
    peranan Pemohon, Pelulus;
    Pemohon -> Pelulus: hantar Nombor;
    Pelulus -> Pemohon: hantar Benar;
    tamat;
}
```

## Keywords

### Core
fungsi (fn), biar (let), ubah (mut), kalau (if), lain (else), untuk (for),
selagi (while), pulang (return), padan (match), bentuk (struct), pilihan (enum),
sifat (trait), laksana (impl), awam (pub), modul (mod), guna (use)

### Security
rahsia (secret), dedah (declassify), bukti (prove), masa_tetap (constant-time),
tercemar (tainted), bersihkan (sanitize)

### Effects
kesan (effect), bersih (pure), laku (perform), kendali (handle)

### Linearity
sekali (linear), paling (affine), mesti (relevant)

### JALINAN (Distributed Computing)
pelakon (actor), lahir (spawn), hantar (send), terima (recv),
koreografi (choreography), peranan (role), keadaan (state),
penyelia (supervisor), gabung (merge), cincang (hash), sahkan (verify)

### Capabilities
keupayaan (capability), perlukan (require), beri (grant), tarik_balik (revoke)

### Session Types
sesi (session), pilih (select), cabang (branch), tamat (end)

## CLI

```bash
riinac check file.rii     # Type-check + verify security
riinac run file.rii       # Execute directly
riinac build file.rii     # Compile to native via C
riinac emit-c file.rii    # Generate C source
riinac emit-ir file.rii   # Generate IR
riinac repl               # Interactive mode
riinac fmt file.rii       # Format source
riinac doc file.rii       # Generate HTML docs
riinac lsp                # Language server
riinac verify --fast      # Quick verification (pre-commit)
riinac verify --full      # Full verification (pre-push)
riinac pkg init           # Initialize package
riinac pkg add dep        # Add dependency
riinac pkg build          # Build with dependencies
riinac mcp                # MCP server for AI tools
```
